title: Crestline Credit Card Minimum Taken at the Desk: Calculation of the Amount
content:
**Clause.** On the Crestline Credit Card, the minimum the desk takes is a core, which is the product's payment floor, plus any past-due amount, plus the late fee posted in the statement's cycle, less the payments made toward that statement since it closed, never less than zero, rounded half up to the cent.

The product's payment floor is the figure in the product's minimum payment terms.

## Definitions

- **The late fee posted in the statement's cycle** is the most recent late fee, when it was posted on or before the statement's closing date and charged for the statement that closed immediately before it, no more than 31 days earlier; one late fee at most is charged for each statement.
- **The past-due amount** is that earlier statement's minimum less the payments made toward it and not returned, never less than zero, and it is zero when no late fee was posted in the cycle.
- **Payments made toward a statement** are the payments recorded against that statement's closing date, less any of them returned unpaid.

## How the amounts combine

Every amount a rule of this schedule adds to or takes off the minimum enters it that way, and a core a rule sets replaces the payment floor; where a rule makes the core the whole minimum, nothing else is added to it or taken off it but the payments made toward the statement since it closed; the minimum is never less than zero and is rounded half up to the cent once, on the final figure.

## Worked figure (hypothetical account, payment floor of 33 USD)

| Item | Figure |
|---|---|
| Core: the payment floor | 33.00 |
| Past-due amount: earlier minimum 57.00, paid toward it 14.00 | 43.00 |
| Late fee posted in the cycle | 27.00 |
| Payments made toward the latest statement since it closed | 20.00 |
| Minimum taken at the desk: 33.00 plus 43.00 plus 27.00, less 20.00 | 83.00 |

With no late fee posted in the cycle and no payment since closing, the same account's minimum at the desk is the floor alone, 33.00. When payments since closing exceed the total, the minimum is 0.00.
